title: VMware vSphere 4.1: Planning, Installing and Administering Virtual Machines
summary: ‘vSphere 4.1; Planning, Installing, & Administering VM’ is a free online course for beginners that introduces you to virtual machines. To get started, you must install VMware Tools in the guest operating system. This course provides an overview of installing and configuring a vSphere environment. Learn how to configure hostname resolutions and manage ESX/ESXi.

title: A Beginner's Guide to MongoDB
summary: If you want to become a highly skilled developer or a DBA, MongoDB is an excellent place to start since it's user-friendly, adaptable and efficient. In this course, you will discover how to launch a fully-functional web app in no time. The objective is to build a trustworthy foundation that will prepare you for database administration. After acquiring this knowledge, you will immediately be more marketable to potential employers.

title: Programming Using C++ Language - A Complete Guide
summary: Do you aspire to create applications and software but don’t know how to code or where to start? Look no further! This course gives you this knowledge and provides the opportunity you seek. It serves as a complete guide for you to learn to code from start to finish using C++, the powerful all-purpose programming language behind all the major applications, websites and software. This course busts the myth that coding is just for the chosen few.

title: An Introduction to Julia Programming Language
summary: The Julia programming language is designed for those needing a fast tool that you can use for operations that demand speed, such as statistics and numerical computation. If you are new to Julia, this course will walk you through the basics, covering areas such as variables, strings and loops. We will explore advanced subjects such as error handling and metaprogramming. This short course is a quick way to start programming using Julia.

title: An Introduction to the ESP32 Web Server
summary: The ESP32 board has a Wi-Fi feature that allows it to create its own access point for other devices to join or connect to other Wi-Fi routers. With the utilization of the Wi-Fi feature, you can programme the ESP32 to serve web pages to web clients. This course will show you how to use the Arduino Integrated Development Environment to programme the ESP32 and turn it into a web server that controls outputs such as LEDs.

title: Diploma in Developing Applications with Kotlin in Android Studio
summary: Developing Applications with Kotlin in Android Studio is a free online course that explores the use of Kotlin for creating applications. It covers a wide range of concepts from working with version control systems to the use of web request and chat APIs. You will learn how to navigate the Android Studio console, create chat applications and upload them to the Google Play Store, along with many other key components of Kotlin.

title: Visual Basic - Working with Classes, Scope and Namespaces
summary: This free video-based course teaches you about working with classes, scope, and namespaces in the Visual Basic (VB) programming language. Learn how VB helps developers create programs that act as front-ends for databases. Delve into VB’s classes and methods, the differences between them, and their functions. You will also learn about working with the .NET framework class library, an essential part of Visual Basic.

title: Android App Building 101- Introduction
summary: Entry-level and skilled Android developers are already in a growing market. MIT App Inventor 2 is an impressive tool for getting started as a programmer. This Android course aims to educate on the fundamentals of the structural and functional elements of App Inventor, such as the ‘Designer’ viewer and ‘block’ editor. Enrol in this brief video-based training course and learn how to build apps without typing a line of code.

title: Android App Building 103 - My Business and Free Form Task
summary: Do you want to create an application but lack the necessary skills and expertise to make that possible? This course teaches you how to create two types of Android apps: a business app and a free form tasks app using App Inventor 2. You'll explore all the stages, from designing a basic home screen layout with the ‘designer’ editor to implementing various functionality using the ‘block’ editor and publishing the apps.

title: Machine Learning for Apps
summary: This free online machine learning course covers foundational python for machine learning. You'll learn what machine learning (ML) is and how it is applied, study the five steps of ML integration, and look into the installation of Anaconda and Atom including their applications. You'll learn how to build an iOS app and create a classification model capable of making predictions using neural networks, and much more!

title: Build an eCommerce Site with Angular 5
summary: This free online course, "Build an eCommerce Site with Angular 5", teaches students how to use the tools in Angular 5 to build a site for the eCommerce business. It provides a demonstration of Angular's tools and code editor. Students will also learn about adding routing to app.module.ts. You will also learn about proper page layout. So, why wait? Start this course today and learn about building an eCommerce site with Angular 5.

title: AWS Hands-on: Developing with Lambda, SQS, and SNS
summary: Ever wonder how email or SMS messages arrive in your inbox or mobile? This free course will teach you how to develop such systems using Amazon Web Services (AWS), enabling users to subscribe to your service and receive notifications. You will master software development fundamentals using Boto3, a Python library, and coding in Python. So, obtain an in-demand skill by taking this course and creating today's systems from scratch.

title: Creating a Carousel and a Task List using JavaScript
summary: In this course, you will learn how to use JavaScript to create a dynamic carousel image slider and task list for a webpage. See how to add images to a slider, display information on an image, style, and add interactivity to a carousel. You will also learn to create a fully functional task list with the ability to add, delete and cross out items, as well as download, store, and retrieve the list from local storage.

title: The Essentials of Deluge scripts and API for Zoho CRM Functions
summary: Do you use Zoho's customer relationship management (CRM) software? Do you want to streamline and optimise your business processes? Or do you want to take advantage of workflow automation's advantages? Maybe you wish to benefit from integration with third-party services? Then you've come to the right place since this course will walk you through the workings and applications of Deluge scripts, APIs, and custom apps in Zoho CRM.

title: Advanced Programming in iOS11 and Swift 4
summary: Core Data is one of the most popular frameworks provided by Apple for iOS and macOS apps. One can use it to manage the model layer object in an application. This course introduces you to the definition of core data, how to create core data entities and attributes, and how to manipulate core data. You will also learn how to develop intelligent features and enable new experiences. Register for this course today and begin your next learning journey!

title: WebVR Programming Using A -Frame Framework
summary: We have designed this course on WebVR Programming using the A-Frame framework to equip you with firsthand skills and knowledge required to develop virtual reality websites. This course will teach you how to set up an A-Frame to create a virtual reality website. Drawing a box and applying texture and lighting are some of the defined skills. Also, learn how to load models, images, videos, and objects to the scene, enhancing the users’ experience.
